title: Onboarding, files, history and operational continuity

journeys.title: Fresh signup, company bootstrap and first transaction
journeys.fixture: New synthetic supported signup; no existing company trading; plan/country/domain chosen explicitly.

cases.title: Fresh company creation
cases.given: New account authorized by owner staging scope.
cases.expected: Correct Owner membership, CoA, job/module defaults and chosen entity; zero trading; record actual created versus merely prepared.

cases.title: First included operation
cases.given: Fresh loaded Owner; sales included.
cases.expected: AR0/bank100/revenue100; included module works without manual hidden repair; broken bootstrap retained as failure.

cases.title: Add company with custom existing tenant
cases.given: Tenant A has custom flags and history.
cases.action: Add empty tenant B and switch backA.
cases.expected: B correctly bootstrapped; A flags/history untouched; active actor verified on both.

cases.title: Invalid or partial onboarding
cases.given: Missing required entity/profile data.
cases.expected: No falsely completed unusable company; recoverable explicit state; no duplicate memberships/CoA on retry.

cases.title: Company type versus business model
cases.given: Physical sole-proprietor and service limited company.
cases.expected: Entity legal/domain ceiling separate from product business type; unsupported combination explicitly explained.

journeys.title: Receipt, product image and rental photo lifecycle
journeys.fixture: Synthetic small valid supported image/PDF; hash known privately; own expense/product/event and real foreign records.

cases.title: Authorized upload and readback
cases.given: Own valid record; supported synthetic bytes.
cases.action: Upload/reload/download own receipt/image/photo through each applicable adapter.
cases.expected: Bytes or documented transform/hash, MIME, actor, tenant, record link and metadata agree; upload does not post extra money.

cases.title: Wrong magic or truncated bytes
cases.given: Filename.png with harmless text or truncated fixture.
cases.expected: Validate actual content/bounds; reject without replacing old valid object or creating dangling DB pointer.

cases.title: Size, dimension and empty bounds
cases.given: Below/at/above actual documented byte/pixel limits; zero-byte fixture.
cases.action: Upload each in isolated bounded tests.
cases.expected: Explicit supported limits enforced; noncrashing errors; no unbounded decoding; exact limits discovered/pinned before run.

cases.title: Replace with storage failure
cases.given: Existing valid attachment; injected isolated storage/DB failure.
cases.expected: Old valid attachment remains or recoverable explicit state; no published dangling link/orphan accumulation; cleanup scoped.

cases.title: Foreign link and stale permission
cases.given: Real foreign record/object plus role revoked after valid upload.
cases.expected: Authorization checked against tenant/record/current scope before signing; own current positive control works.

journeys.title: Fresh schema, prior-release upgrade and compatible rollback
journeys.fixture: Ephemeral isolated PostgreSQL16 and synthetic golden DB/files; current and prior product SHAs explicitly pinned.
policyGaps: This is an isolated execution plan. No migrations, restores or production operations are authorized by publication itself.

cases.title: Fresh migrations
cases.given: Empty authorized isolated DB.
cases.action: Apply complete migration chain and bootstrap first transaction.
cases.expected: Schema/version/RLS runtime roles and basic finance work; direct owner migration success alone not nonowner business proof.

cases.title: Upgrade populated prior release
cases.given: Golden invoices/allocations/stock/rental/files exist.
cases.expected: Counts/checksums and semantic balances/source links preserved; authenticate roles and read/download after upgrade.

cases.title: Interrupted migration
cases.given: Ephemeral fault before/after designated migration boundary.
cases.expected: No silently half-version accepted service; safe idempotent completion or documented recovery; first failure retained.

cases.title: Code rollback compatibility
cases.given: New schema/data and prior app version.
cases.expected: Code rollback compatibility verified separately; never assert data restored merely by reverting image.

cases.title: Unsupported downgrade
cases.given: Prior app cannot safely read new data.
cases.expected: Explicit operational block and recovery requirements; no destructive table drop/recreate or unapproved production restore.

journeys.title: Audit, release evidence and fixture cleanup
journeys.fixture: Synthetic run-owned tenants; exact product/QA/config/fixture fingerprints; public artifacts allowlisted.

cases.title: Attributable accepted event
cases.given: Own invoice100 posted by known actor.
cases.expected: Who/what/when/reason/correlation/source retained; no credentials/cookies/customer records/raw trace in public content.

cases.title: Missing or cancelled release check
cases.given: Required same-SHA check absent/skipped/cancelled.
cases.action: Evaluate release gate in separate authorized setup.
cases.expected: Fail closed; green discovery or workbook metadata cannot promote candidate.

cases.title: Artifact mismatch
cases.given: Tested image/config differs from deployment.
cases.expected: Invalidate affected acceptance; preserve original record; require exact artifact revalidation.

cases.title: Bounded load
cases.given: Explicit isolated infrastructure and agreed budget.
cases.expected: Record p95/errors/integrity with declared workload; no claim from average-only result or shared staging stress.

cases.title: Cleanup twice
cases.given: Run-owned unneeded fixtures identified; issued history retained per policy.
cases.expected: Idempotent and tenant/run-scoped; other runs and required first-failure evidence survive; no broad reset.

journeys.title: Company archive and recovery — execution last
journeys.fixture: Owner; synthetic completed business fixture; newly created operationally empty target; no real archives in Git.
policyGaps: Actual encrypted backup/restore remains LAST; no archive operation executed during workbook construction. Existing45 scenarios retain their original IDs and acceptance gaps.

cases.title: Export contract review
cases.given: Owner export capability; source golden identities.
cases.action: Plan DB+files export only after other workflow execution.
cases.expected: Preserve existing45 archive scenarios; this five-case summary does not replace them; private encrypted files/passwords never public.

cases.title: Empty-target restore precondition
cases.given: Target trading/nonempty or identity unknown.
cases.expected: Refuse unsafe target; supported new empty tenant required; never merge/overwrite trading company.

cases.title: Semantic roundtrip
cases.given: Authorized isolated empty target and complete matched DB/files pair.
cases.expected: Remapped IDs valid; journals/AR/AP/stock/layers/fleet/deposits/source links/files/roles and own-login match expected semantics; checksums alone insufficient.

cases.title: Wrong pair, password or interruption
cases.given: Wrong files pair/secret or isolated interrupted restore.
cases.action: Exercise retained archive scenarios under supported recovery.
cases.expected: No falsely complete target or leaked secret; explicit safe recovery; original source untouched.

cases.title: Operator recovery distinct
cases.given: Separate DR/RPO/RTO scope not authorized by staging data permission.
cases.expected: Record as separate infrastructure requirement; tenant archive pass is not operator disaster-recovery certification.

author: independent-QA-agent
moneyConvention: LKR, two decimal places; numerical examples in rupees unless oracle label says cents
